recognize_zh: 低倍脾臟切片中，紅髓被瀰漫的小淋巴樣細胞取代，看不到白髓結節，並散布大小不一、形狀不規則的紅血球湖（blood lakes），符合毛細胞白血病侵犯脾臟。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of small, evenly spaced mononuclear cells throughout the red pulp
Numerous irregular pools of extravasated red cells (blood lakes / pseudosinuses)
Absence of recognizable white pulp follicles in this field
Cells have pale cytoplasm imparting a lighter, spaced-out appearance at low power
describe_en: Low-power section of spleen shows effacement of normal architecture by a diffuse red pulp infiltrate of small, evenly spaced lymphoid cells with pale cytoplasm. Numerous irregular red cell lakes are distributed throughout, and white pulp follicles are not identified. Findings are consistent with splenic involvement by hairy cell leukemia; higher-power evaluation and immunohistochemistry (CD20, annexin A1, CD123, BRAF V600E) are recommended.

ddx.vs: SMZL shows a micronodular white pulp–based infiltrate with marginal zone differentiation rather than diffuse red pulp with blood lakes.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Also red pulp predominant, so annexin A1 negativity, CD25 negativity and wild-type BRAF are needed to separate it.
Congestion expands sinuses with red cells and fibrosis but lacks a monotonous neoplastic lymphoid infiltrate.
